name: Billing - SES creation and approval workflow
description: Verifies the Service Entry Sheet (SES) lifecycle: creation from order, approval routing, and PDF generation

planSteps.description: Log in with a role that has billing access (administrativo or gerente) and navigate to /dashboard/billing/ses
Assert that SES list displays with status filters (draft, pending_approval, approved, rejected)
Click 'New SES' and select an existing order to base the SES on
Assert that the SES form is pre-populated with order data (items, quantities, client info)
Edit SES line items if needed, add descriptions, and submit for approval
Assert that SES status changes to 'pending_approval' and appears in the approval queue
Log in with an approver role and navigate to the SES approval view
Review the SES details and click 'Approve'
Assert that SES status changes to 'approved' and invoice creation button becomes available
Generate PDF of the approved SES and verify download
